Name: Custom Music for Stardew Valley
Author: JinxEFG
Description:
Right now, there are 41 Lofi .ogg tracks in the playlist as a default [thanks to DELOSound and VibeHorn]. 

If you would like to add your own music, simply drop your audio files that have been converted to .ogg format into the Music folder inside of the assets folder. 

The game will still play the vanilla music but if you press the music note icon in the top left of the title screen it will turn the vanilla music off. You can also go to the in-game settings you can turn the vanilla music volume all the way off.

This is my first actual mod born of my desire to listen to Lofi while decorating my farm without having to alt tab to access Spotify or setup a queue. I hope everyone enjoys it.

If you would like to show me support to make more mods in the future, you can find my Kofi [url=https://ko-fi.com/jinxefg]here[/url]!
